scope: Focused parity for the five drifted protected sources of the EIG-4 R-series (R1-R3). The pytest command is the union of the registered PROOF_TESTS for isar/drive/objective.py, isar/drive/session_log.py and isar/schema/hypotheses.py, plus the reviewer-supplied proof tests for isar/session/driver.py and isar/session/worker.py, which carry no registered entry.
notes: isar/session/driver.py is the only protected_semantic drift. Its whole diff since the anchor is the slice-10 force_masters targeted-refit path: refit SCOPE, not fit mathematics, model selection, weighting or delivery semantics.

Proportionate STAT-2b evidence for that file is the slice-10 A/B on the O41_Test10 workspace copy, which produced a byte-identical predictive artifact (sha256 prefix 5b04814954e0) between a whole-batch force refit and the targeted force_masters refit. That measurement is cited rather than re-run; nothing in the intervening commits touched the compared path.

The four remaining drifts are adjacent and non-semantic: an additive session-log event kind, a steering point-ceiling default, centralised budget constants plus an analysis-limit clamp, and an additive worker JSONL protocol field guarded so an absent key leaves behaviour unchanged.
